articles.title: Broadcom Forecasts Boom in AI Chip Sales
articles.summary: Broadcom predicted a surge in artificial intelligence chip sales over the next two years, helping renew optimism that it can challenge Nvidia’s dominance in the lucrative market. The company also is on track to top earnings of $30 a share in fiscal 2028, outpacing Wall Street estimates. Bloomberg Intelligence analyst Matt Bloxham has the details. (Source: Bloomberg)

articles.title: Markets Rebound as Oil, Yields & AI Remain in Focus | The Close 9/2/2026
articles.summary: Bloomberg Television brings you the latest news and analysis leading up to the final minutes and seconds before and after the closing bell on Wall Street. Today's guests are Alger Executive Vice President, Portfolio Manager Ankur Crawford, ProShares Head of Research, Active Investments CIO Alessio De Longis, Oppenheimer Managing Director & Senior Analyst Brian Nagel, MongoDB CEO CJ Desai, Edward Jones Head of Investment Strategy Mona Mahajan, DigitalBridge CEO Marc Ganzi, Skylar Capital Management Managing Partner & CIO Bill Perkins, Magnetar Capital Founder Alec Litowitz, & NBA Hall of Famer Shaquille O’Neal. (Source: Bloomberg)

articles.title: Microsoft to Disclose Azure Sales After Years of Investor Gripes
articles.summary: Microsoft Corp. will begin disclosing quarterly sales for its Azure cloud unit, reversing course after years of criticism from Wall Street regarding a lack of information about the company’s most important growth engine.
articles.author: Brody Ford and Matt Day

articles.title: Upwind Raises $300 Million at $3.8 Billion Valuation for AI, Cloud Cybersecurity
articles.summary: Upwind Security, a startup offering cybersecurity for artificial intelligence and cloud applications, is raising fresh financing that values the company at $3.8 billion, according to people familiar with the matter.
articles.author: Marissa Newman

articles.title: Tencent-Backed Enflame’s IPO Draws 4,073 Times Retail Demand
articles.summary: The initial public offering of Shanghai Enflame Technology Co., a company backed by Tencent Holdings Ltd., drew strong demand from retail investors, as the last of the so-called “four little dragons” of leading Chinese artificial intelligence chipmakers taps the public market.
articles.author: Bloomberg News

articles.title: Lyte Closes $165 Million Round, Bringing AI Startup's Valuation to $1.6 Billion
articles.summary: Lyte, a fast-growing robotics and artificial intelligence startup from top members of Apple Inc.'s Face ID team, has secured about $165 million in a new funding round that more than triples the company’s valuation to $1.6 billion.
articles.author: Samantha Kelly

articles.title: Palo Alto Networks Tops Profit Outlook on AI Security Demand
articles.summary: The cybersecurity firm Palo Alto Networks Inc. issued a profit outlook for the year that exceeded Wall Street’s expectations, fueled by corporate demand for stronger defenses against advancing artificial intelligence systems.
articles.author: Ignacio Gonzalez

articles.title: Polymarket Valuation Hits $21B, Led By Trump Jr.'s 1789
articles.summary: Bloomberg's Todd Gillespie joins Scarlet Fu and Tim Stenovec on "Bloomberg Crypto." Venture capital firm 1789 Capital is leading a new funding round for Polymarket that will give the prediction-markets platform a $21 billion post-money valuation. (Source: Bloomberg)

articles.title: JPMorgan’s Aliaga Says Market Can Absorb ‘Attractive’ Tech Debt
articles.summary: JPMorgan Asset Management’s Stephanie Aliaga said that the bond market can absorb the growing supply of hyperscaler debt, as rising artificial intelligence demand reassures investors that the companies can pay their obligations.
articles.author: Ed Ludlow

articles.title: AI Boom Fuels a New Tech Debt Binge
articles.summary: Big Tech is increasingly turning to debt to finance the massive buildout of AI infrastructure. JPMorgan Asset Management's global market strategist Stephanie Aliaga explains why hyperscaler bond issuance is poised to keep growing, how the market is absorbing the new supply, and why stronger visibility into AI returns could help sustain the spending boom. She joins Ed Ludlow on "Bloomberg Tech." (Source: Bloomberg)

articles.title: Wonderful raises $550M at $5B valuation for its AI automation platform
articles.summary: Artificial intelligence agent startup Wonderful AI BV today announced that it has raised $550 million in funding. The Series C round was led by Insight Partners, which was also the headline backer of the company’s previous raise in March. Salesforce chipped in as well along with Index Ventures, IVP, Vine Ventures, 9Yards and Bessemer. articles.title: Former Apple Engineers’ Physical AI Startup Lyte Raises $165M At $1.6B Valuation
articles.summary: Lyte, a physical AI startup building sensing and perception technology for robots, has raised a Maverick Silicon-led $165 million Series C funding at a $1.6 billion post-money valuation.
articles.author: Judy Rider

articles.title: Chinese AI Lab MiniMax on Business Strategy
articles.summary: Yeyi Yun, Co-Founder & President at MiniMax, discusses the Chinese AI lab's business strategy from the sidelines of the "Goldman Sachs Asia Leaders Conference." (Source: Bloomberg)

articles.summary: The firm, 1789 Capital, led the funding round that reportedly will total around $1 billion.

articles.title: Anthropic IPO Could Open AI Listings Floodgates: Madrona
articles.summary: The IA40 list from Madrona is back, spotlighting the private companies shaping the next phase of AI. Matt McIlwain, managing director at Madrona, explains how the list is assembled, why OpenAI, Anthropic and Databricks dominate AI fundraising, and how a successful Anthropic IPO could open the door for a new wave of public offerings in 2027. He joins Ed Ludlow on "Bloomberg Tech." (Source: Bloomberg)

articles.title: Forrester CEO Sizes Up the AI Boom
articles.summary: Nvidia makes another big bet on the future of AI with a $3.5 billion investment in MediaTek, as investors gear up for a potentially record-breaking Anthropic IPO. Forrester Research Founder and CEO George Colony weighs in on the AI boom, whether the hype is justified and what comes next. He speaks on Bloomberg Open Interest. (Source: Bloomberg)

articles.title: AI Adoption Is Finally Showing Up in Fundamentals
articles.summary: Michelle Weaver, head of US thematic research at Morgan Stanley, says companies are beginning to see measurable benefits from AI as adoption moves from experimentation into production. About 25% of S&P 500 companies are now quantifying benefits from AI, up from 14% a year ago, with AI adopters also seeing relative forward margin expansion. “You’re starting to see this come into the fundamentals.” This interview aired Aug. 27, 2026. (Source: Bloomberg)

articles.title: Anthropic’s Mega-IPO Plan Looms Over Packed US Listing Calendar
articles.summary: Anthropic PBC’s IPO is casting a long shadow over companies’ US listing plans, as they try to find room for their deals to grab attention after the Sept. 7 Labor Day holiday. The Claude developer is preparing to file publicly for an initial public offering that’s expected to raise as much as SpaceX’s record $86.2 billion debut, if not more, in the coming weeks. Some firms and their backers are finding it hard to get the attention of long-term-oriented investors and sovereign wealth funds when the prospect of an Anthropic IPO is imminent, according to people familiar with the preparations. For a closer look, we speak with Bailey Lipschultz, Senior Equities Reporter for Bloomberg News. (Source: Bloomberg)

articles.title: WhatsApp Remittance Startup Félix Secures $200M Series C Led By A16z, General Catalyst
articles.summary: Félix, a Miami-based AI-powered WhatsApp remittance platform for Latino immigrants, announced on Tuesday that it has secured $200 million in Series C funding co-led by Andreessen Horowitz and General Catalyst.
articles.author: Judy Rider
